goals: Describe common symptoms (I have a headache / My back hurts / I don't feel well).
Understand and give advice with should, and rules with have to.
Get through a clinic visit in English: check-in, describing the problem, medicine instructions.
Pronounce TH clearly (throat, health, three, think) instead of S or F.

easy: Do you often catch a cold?
Is there a clinic near your home?
medium: What do you do when you have a headache?
What do you do to stay healthy?
hard: Tell me about the last time you were sick. What happened?
What advice would you give a friend who can't sleep?
Do you think people in Taiwan see the doctor too often? Why or why not?

key_phrases.en: I have a headache / a fever / a sore throat.
You have to take it three times a day.
I hope you feel better soon!

grammar.point_en: should (advice) vs. have to (necessary / a rule)
grammar.point_zh: should 表示建議；have to 表示一定要
grammar.explain_zh: should 是「應該、最好」，是給建議：You should drink more water。have to 是「一定要、必須」，通常是規定或沒有選擇：You have to take this after meals。兩個後面都接原形動詞。主詞是 he/she 時 have to 要變成 has to，但 should 不變。

examples.en: You have to take this medicine after meals.
She has to see a doctor today.
examples.zh: 她今天一定得去看醫生。

common_mistake.why_zh: should 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。

sound_focus.sentence: I think I have a sore throat and a fever of thirty-eight.

mini_lesson: Step 1 (5 min): Warm-up. Mime symptoms (hold your head, cough, touch your throat) and she guesses: 'You have a headache!' Then swap: she mimes, you guess.

Step 2 (7 min): Vocabulary. Teach the two patterns 'I have a + headache / fever / sore throat / runny nose' and 'My ___ hurts.' Point to body parts (head, back, stomach, throat) and she makes a sentence for each.

Step 3 (7 min): Grammar. Write 'should = advice' and 'have to = must' on the board. You give a problem ('I can't sleep'), she gives advice with should. Then read a real Taiwan medicine bag (藥袋) together and turn it into 'You have to take it ___.'

Step 4 (6 min): Sound focus (TH). Tongue tip lightly between the teeth, then blow air. Contrast sink/think, mouse/mouth, free/three. Practice throat, health, three, mouth, then 'I think I have a sore throat and a fever of thirty-eight.'
Step 5 (5 min): Speaking. Quick clinic run-through: she checks in at the counter, describes her problem, and asks 'Is it serious?' This prepares her for the role-play block.

roleplays.title: At the clinic counter
roleplays.setup_zh: 她感冒了，到診所掛號，跟櫃台人員說明狀況。

lines.en: Good morning. How can I help you?
Hi. I don't feel well. I'd like to see a doctor.
lines.zh: 你好，我不太舒服，想看醫生。

lines.en: Sure. Do you have your health insurance card?
Yes, here you are.
Thank you. What's the matter today?
I have a sore throat and a runny nose.
lines.zh: 我喉嚨痛，還一直流鼻水。

lines.en: Do you have a fever?
I think so. Maybe thirty-eight degrees.
OK. Please have a seat. The doctor will call your name.
Thank you. How long is the wait?

roleplays.title: Seeing the doctor
roleplays.setup_zh: 她在診間跟醫生說明症狀，醫生給建議和開藥。她要聽懂醫囑並主動提問。

lines.en: Hello. What seems to be the problem?
I have a bad cough and a headache.
I see. When did it start?
It started ___ days ago.
OK. Open your mouth and say 'ah'. Now breathe in, please.
Ahh... Is it serious, doctor?
No, it's just a bad cold. Are you allergic to any medicine?
Yes, I'm allergic to ___. / No, I'm not.
OK. You have to take this medicine three times a day, after meals.
Three times a day, after meals. Should I stay home from work?
lines.zh: 一天三次，飯後吃。我需要請假在家嗎？

lines.en: Yes. You should get some rest for two days and drink lots of water.
OK. Thank you, doctor.

teacher_twists: Give the medicine instructions quickly ('Take two before bed and one in the morning') so she has to ask 'Sorry, can you say that again?'
Ask lifestyle questions ('Do you exercise? Do you sleep well?') so she answers with frequency adverbs.
Tell her she has to come back in three days; she must agree on a day and time.

homework_zh: 拿家裡的藥袋，用英文寫下怎麼吃（例如 I have to take it twice a day, after meals.）。
寫 4 句給生病朋友的建議，用 You should / You shouldn't。
練習 th：每天唸 5 次 I think I have a sore throat and a fever of thirty-eight. 舌尖放在上下牙齒中間。
